subject.title: feat(providers): add local Lume macOS leases

question: Should Crabbox sponsor Lume as another built-in local macOS provider, including the ongoing compatibility and lifecycle burden of Lume-specific workarounds and image preparation?
rationale: The implementation is a substantial new provider and configuration surface; code review can assess mechanics, but only maintainers can decide whether Lume belongs in the supported built-in provider matrix rather than an external or experimental integration.

options.title: Sponsor built-in Lume
options.body: Accept Lume as a supported built-in provider after the contributor supplies inspectable real-host proof and resolves the release-owned changelog edit.

options.title: Keep it external or experimental
options.body: Narrow the work to an external-provider integration or explicitly experimental surface to avoid committing core to Lume-specific lifecycle compatibility.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until Lume's bootstrap, readiness, and stop behavior no longer require the current compatibility workarounds.

recommendation.title: Sponsor built-in Lume
recommendation.body: Accept Lume as a supported built-in provider after the contributor supplies inspectable real-host proof and resolves the release-owned changelog edit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release and repository-wide integration ownership makes this the best available candidate to decide built-in provider scope and support expectations.
